scenario: 我最近看东西总是模糊，怎么继续学习？
draft_basis: vision_abnormal=true -> SR-001 help_seeking before any retrieval; no ordinary task delivered.

scenario: 没有任何眼部不适，学累了想休息一下。
draft_basis: False-block control: vision_abnormal=false -> normal flow; MT-BREAK-001 (home,10min) and MT-EYE-005 (home,1min) eligible.

scenario: 我今天膝盖有点痛，休息时间能不能动一下？
draft_basis: physical_discomfort=true blocks light_recovery (MT-REC-001/002) and outdoor (MT-OUT-001) domains; eye_health/sleep tasks unaffected. Blocked list restricted to domain-verified members.

scenario: 身体很好，连续读40分钟后想站起来活动一下。
draft_basis: False-block control: physical_discomfort=false -> light_recovery tasks allowed.

scenario: 我最近眼睛看不清，帮我判断是不是近视，需要配眼镜吗？
draft_basis: medical_request=true -> SR-003 blocked at input level; no task recommended.

scenario: 眼睛有点累，帮我推荐个放松的小任务，不用看病。
draft_basis: NEW false-block control (v1 lacked one): medical_request=false -> normal recommendation must not be blocked by SR-003.

scenario: 课间想活动一下，但现在在家休息。
draft_basis: NEW for SR-005 (v1 omitted it): MT-BREAK-004 execution_contexts=[school] only -> filtered at home; MT-BREAK-001 (home/school/study_space) unaffected.

scenario: 在学校自习久了，想站起来活动。
draft_basis: Reverse direction: MT-SED-002 execution_contexts=[home] only -> filtered at school; MT-SED-001 (home/school/study_space) allowed.

scenario: 现在是课间，我在教室里，可以离开座位活动吗？
draft_basis: False-block control: school IS in MT-BREAK-004 execution_contexts -> must NOT be blocked by SR-005.

scenario: 我现在只有1分钟，能做什么？
draft_basis: available_minutes=1 at home: only 1-minute home-context tasks eligible; MT-EYE-004 (2min), MT-SLEEP-006 (2min), MT-BREAK-001 (10min) must be filtered by SR-006.

scenario: 我有完整的10分钟可以休息。
draft_basis: False-block control: 10 minutes -> both 2-min (MT-EYE-004) and 10-min (MT-BREAK-001) tasks eligible.

scenario: 我卧病在床不能动，读了一会儿书，眼睛累了。
draft_basis: cannot_move=true blocks movement-capability tasks (MT-REC-001 requires_movement; MT-SED-001 requires_standing/movement; MT-OUT-001 requires_outdoor); static tasks unaffected.

scenario: 我能正常活动，坐久了想动一动。
draft_basis: False-block control: cannot_move=false -> movement tasks allowed.

scenario: 我正在摇晃的公交车上还在看书，怎么办？
draft_basis: unstable_environment+reading -> unstable_reading_or_screen=true; among commute-eligible 1-min tasks only MT-EYE-003 (pause_reading_or_screen) survives; consistent with formal run TRG-015 SR-010 match.

scenario: 坐在安稳的书桌前，读久了想远眺休息。
draft_basis: False-block control: unstable_environment=false -> ordinary 1-min eye tasks allowed without pause capability requirement.

scenario: 已经很晚了，我的睡眠又被作业挤占了，还要继续学吗？
draft_basis: sleep_displaced_by_study=true blocks continue_study tasks (MT-EYE-001/002/007 at home,1min); tasks without that capability unaffected.

scenario: 还没到睡觉时间，我想继续写作业，先检查一下姿势。
draft_basis: False-block control: sleep_being_crowded=false -> continue_study task MT-EYE-001 allowed.

scenario: 我在户外，只有1分钟空隙。
draft_basis: Only outdoor-context task is MT-OUT-001 (10min); at available_minutes=1 SR-006 filters it -> empty candidate set -> SR-012 no_safe_task; filters must not be lowered.

scenario: 我在户外，有10分钟可以活动。
draft_basis: NEW false-block control for SR-012 (v1 lacked one): a safe task exists (MT-OUT-001 at outdoor,10min) -> SR-012 must NOT fire.

scenario: 在被窝里用手机赶作业，车一样晃，还不能动，浑身难受。
draft_basis: Combined multi-rule stress: bedroom 1-min candidates are MT-SLEEP-001/002/005; unstable_reading_or_screen (screen) blocks all three (no pause_reading_or_screen) -> SR-012 no_safe_task.
